bullets.text: The Madras High Court kept the development ban active near the Pallikaranai marsh and advised petitioners to approach the Supreme Court, so the office should monitor upcoming legal filings.
Chennai faces severe summer power supply risks as transmission and distribution upgrades lag behind schedule, so the office should track TANGEDCO's progress on completing delayed substations.
The Madras High Court directed the State Wetland Authority to expedite study work on the Pallikaranai marsh, so the office should watch for compliance updates from the authority.

Meat waste has caused health hazards at the old fish market in Pazhaverkadu within Ponneri constituency, so the local team should coordinate immediate sanitation cleanup measures with municipal authorities.
Police arrested three individuals in Avadi for usurping land worth Rs 2 crore using forged certificates, so the district team should monitor further police investigations into land fraud syndicates.
Karnataka announced a 1000 MW data centre roadmap at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, so the portfolio team should review Tamil Nadu's competitive positioning in data centre capacity.
The DMK leadership strongly criticized TVK's proposed health policy regarding medical and liquor corporation functions, so the office should watch for further political exchanges on this matter.
